integrity: The included CHECK.py corroborates finitely many values and high-order samples; the infinite theorem follows from the displayed analytical proof, not numerical extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Only integer harmonic degrees in dimension 3 and the quartic mixed radial-angular norm. The first two cited papers already introduce the modal integrals and global mode ordering. The new contribution is an exact all-mode evaluation and its leading high-degree asymptotic. The full text of one closely relevant 2026 manuscript and possible equivalent older special-function tables were not entirely available for comparison; publication priority has not been independently verified.
title: Exact quartic Bessel modal profile and logarithmic angular decay in dimension three
